environment.description: Same EKS cluster but the auth-service pod runs in namespace 'payments' which has a Cilium CiliumNetworkPolicy (not standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy) applied at L3/L4 with a default-deny egress posture. The policy spec allows egress only to the internal service CIDR 10.96.0.0/12 on ports 443 and 5432, and to CoreDNS on UDP/53. The link-local range 169.254.0.0/16 is not included in any allowlist entry. Additionally, the node uses a custom iptables PREROUTING chain that drops packets from pod network namespace to 169.254.169.254 as a defense-in-depth measure, though this is considered secondary to the Cilium policy. Note: the CiliumNetworkPolicy uses toEndpoints and toCIDR selectors (not toCIDRSet with except blocks), meaning the 169.254.0.0/16 range is implicitly denied rather than explicitly blocked.
